journey.name: bip21 core validation
journey.description: Preconditions: an onboarded English-language regtest wallet with at least 100,000 sats in Savings, Quickpay disabled, and a bitkit-core release containing PR #151. Do not pay any fixture. Open each bitcoin: link through the platform's external-URI delivery command described in this suite's README. This checks that the native decoder rejects ambiguous payments while accepting bitcoin: text as metadata.
